votes.motion: Straw Poll: Support for Budget Amendment No.5 Item A-2 – $2.65M from General Fund Balance to the CIP Fund for City Hall Earthquake Repairs
votes.description: Council members expressed support for allocating $2.65 million from General Fund Balance to the Capital Improvement Program Fund for City Hall earthquake repairs. Council Member Fowler was absent for the vote.

votes.motion: Straw Poll: Support for Budget Amendment No.5 Item A-3 – $242K from the IMS Fund for fiber conduit to improve connections between City facilities
votes.description: Council members expressed support for allocating $242,000 from the IMS Fund for fiber conduit improvements as part of the 200 South reconstruction project. Council Member Fowler was absent for the vote.

votes.motion: Straw Poll: Support for Budget Amendment No.5 Item A-5 – $2.5M from the IMS Fund for Public Safety radio replacements cost increases
votes.description: Council members expressed support for allocating $2.5 million from the IMS Fund to cover cost increases for public safety radio replacements. Council Member Fowler was absent for the vote.

votes.motion: Straw Poll: Support for Budget Amendment No.5 Item E-1 – $4M Grant for US Treasury emergency rental assistance program, including moving forward with public comment and potential adoption
votes.description: Council members expressed support for accepting a $4 million US Treasury emergency rental assistance grant and proceeding with public comment and potential adoption. All seven council members were present and in favor.

votes.motion: Straw Poll: Support for Option D for ARPA Local Business Assistance Grant Awards – $755,718 for 31 applications (the CRC's original request)
votes.description: Council members voted on whether to support Option D, the Community Recovery Committee's original grant recommendation of $755,718 for 31 local business applicants. The majority opposed this option.

votes.motion: Straw Poll: Support for Option A without bonus points for ARPA Local Business Assistance Grant Awards – $1,017,397 for 42 applicants
votes.description: Council members voted on whether to support Option A (hybrid approach) providing $1,017,397 to 42 applicants without bonus points in Phase 2. The majority were in favor.
